headline: Apple advertises an AMS IP formal-verification internship in London
fact: Apple posted London internship 200688723 for its AMS IP team. The project develops property sets for hardware-model functional coverage, formalizes SVA properties, executes formal proofs and studies model-accuracy versus proof-convergence tradeoffs. It also extends the framework to integrate properties at higher levels for system verification. The posting describes proposed intern work within an AMS IP organization; it does not report completed proofs or a deployed formal flow.
